auth.login_page.heading.context: Main page heading on the login form.

auth.login_page.subtitle.ka: ავტორიზაცია იმ ელ. ფოსტითა და პაროლით, რომლითაც მაგთიკომის სისტემებში შესვლა ხდება.
auth.login_page.subtitle.en: Sign in with the same email and password you use for Magticom's internal systems.
auth.login_page.subtitle.context: Explanatory subtitle text under the login heading.

auth.login_page.email_label.context: Label for the email input field on the login form. Byte-identical label reused for the forgot-password modal (login.html:118) and the admin create-user form (base-layout.html:2138, different wording 'ელ. ფოსტა' vs 'ელ.ფოსტა' without space — see auth.users note).

auth.login_page.password_label.context: Label for the password input field on the login form.

auth.login_page.forgot_password_link.context: Link that opens the forgot-password modal.

auth.login_page.password_placeholder.context: Password field placeholder text. Literally says 'any password' — this reflects the intentional dev/QA auth bypass described in project memory (auth-bypass-intentional-pending-ad); flag for a human to confirm this placeholder is still appropriate before go-live.

auth.login_page.or_divider.context: Divider text ('or') between the standard login form and the SSO button.

auth.login_page.sso_button.context: Button label to start the mock corporate SSO flow. Byte-identical heading reused on the SSO selector page itself (routers/auth.py:146).

auth.login_page.footer_copyright.context: Footer copyright line. NOTE: hardcoded year 2024, and a differently-worded copyright appears in article.html:230 ('© 2026 მაგთი საინფორმაციო პორტალი. ყველა უფლება დაცულია.', different year and org name) — flagged in README as an inconsistency for a human to reconcile.

auth.forgot_password_modal.title.context: Modal heading for the forgot-password flow.

auth.forgot_password_modal.email_placeho.context: Placeholder text in the forgot-password email input.

auth.forgot_password_modal.submit_button.context: Submit button label on the forgot-password modal.

auth.forgot_password_modal.error_generic.context: Fallback error message shown when the forgot-password request fails and the server gave no detail.

auth.forgot_password_modal.success_defau.en: Recovery instructions have been sent to your email
auth.forgot_password_modal.success_defau.context: Fallback success message shown client-side if the server response has no message field. The actual server response text is a slightly different, more cautious string — see auth.forgot_password_api.response.

auth.forgot_password_api.response.ka: თუ ეს ელ. ფოსტა რეგისტრირებულია, აღდგენის ინსტრუქცია გამოგზავნილია.
auth.forgot_password_api.response.en: If this email is registered, recovery instructions have been sent.
auth.forgot_password_api.response.context: Actual API response detail for POST /api/auth/forgot-password. Deliberately non-committal to avoid leaking whether an email exists (user-enumeration protection). Similar in meaning but NOT byte-identical to login.html's client-side fallback default — kept as a separate key, flagged in README.

auth.login_page.error_generic.context: Fallback error message shown on the login form when the server gives no specific detail.

auth.login_page.error_server_status.context: Template-literal error message including the raw HTTP status code and response text; contains embedded JS variables that must remain as ICU/interpolation placeholders in the Angular translation.

auth.login_api.invalid_credentials.ka: არასწორი ელ. ფოსტა ან მომხმარებელი არ არსებობს
auth.login_api.invalid_credentials.en: Incorrect email, or the user does not exist
auth.login_api.invalid_credentials.context: HTTPException detail for POST /api/auth/login on failed authentication (401).

auth.sso_page.title.context: Browser <title> of the mock SSO account-selector page (server-rendered inline HTML).

auth.sso_page.subtitle.en: Choose an account to sign in
auth.sso_page.subtitle.context: Subtitle under the SSO page heading.

auth.sso_page.account_system_admin.context: Display name of the first mock SSO account option (admin@magti.ge). NOTE: nearly identical to common.roles.system_admin ('სისტემის ადმინი') but not byte-identical — kept separate, flagged in README as a likely unintentional wording inconsistency.

auth.sso_page.account_content_admin.context: Display name of the second mock SSO account option (content@magti.ge). NOTE: nearly identical to common.roles.content_admin ('კონტენტის ადმინი') but not byte-identical — flagged in README.

auth.sso_page.account_tech_operator.context: Display name of the third mock SSO account option (tech@magti.ge).

auth.sso_page.back_link.context: Link back to the normal login.html page from the SSO selector.

auth.sso_page.error_login_failed.context: Client-side JS error thrown inside the inline SSO page script when the callback fetch fails.

auth.sso_api.user_not_found.context: HTTPException detail for POST /api/auth/sso/callback when the mock SSO email doesn't match a user.

auth.password_policy.summary_prefix.context: Prefix of the HTTPException detail for password-policy validation failures; the full message is this prefix followed by a comma-joined list of the individual rule messages below (e.g. 'პაროლი ვერ აკმაყოფილებს მოთხოვნებს: მინიმუმ 8 სიმბოლო, მინიმუმ ერთი ციფრი'). A human should decide whether to keep this as string concatenation or restructure as a proper i18n list in Angular.

auth.password_policy.rule_min_length.context: One clause of the password policy error list; {PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH} is a server-side constant (currently 8) interpolated via an f-string.

auth.password_policy.rule_digit.context: One clause of the password policy error list.

auth.password_policy.rule_upper.context: One clause of the password policy error list.

auth.password_policy.rule_lower.context: One clause of the password policy error list.

auth.password_policy.access_denied.context: HTTPException detail raised by the shared permission-check dependency when a user lacks a required RBAC permission.

auth.password_policy.admin_only.en: This feature is available to administrators only
auth.password_policy.admin_only.context: HTTPException detail raised by the admin-only dependency guard.

auth.change_password.current_incorrect.context: HTTPException detail for POST /api/users/me/password when the supplied current password doesn't match.

auth.change_password.same_as_old.ka: ახალი პაროლი არ უნდა ემთხვეოდეს ძველს
auth.change_password.same_as_old.en: New password must not match the old one
auth.change_password.same_as_old.context: HTTPException detail when the new password equals the current one.

auth.change_password.success.context: API response detail for a successful self-service password change; also shown as a toast (static/js/app-core.js:4997).

auth.change_password.mismatch.ka: ახალი პაროლი და გამეორება არ ემთხვევა.
auth.change_password.mismatch.en: New password and confirmation do not match.
auth.change_password.mismatch.context: Client-side validation alert shown before submitting a password change if the confirmation field doesn't match.

auth.change_password.failed.context: Fallback error thrown client-side when the change-password API call fails without a detail message.

auth.admin_reset_password.success.context: API response detail when an admin resets another user's password.
